threads.body: `is_recording()` only proves that some recording span is in this context; it does not verify that the context belongs to this invocation. If `ToolInvocation.context` returned an unrelated recording context, this test would still pass, so assert that the extracted span is `invocation.span` while retaining the recording check.

Checking only `parent.span_id` does not verify propagation of the full explicit `SpanContext`; a child in a different trace could still satisfy this assertion. Add a `trace_id` assertion as well, consistent with the parent/child checks in `test_utils.py:824-828`.
